    Sudden infant death syndrome in North Carolina counties

    Source: R/data.R
    nc_sids.Rd

    SIDS deaths and live births in the 100 counties of North Carolina for 1974-78 and 1979-84, with county centroids in projected UTM (zone 17) kilometers. The standard benchmark for disease-cluster detection.

    Usage

    nc_sids

    Format

    A tibble with 100 rows and 10 columns: county, x_km, y_km, lon, lat, births_1974, sids_1974, births_1979, sids_1979, nonwhite_births_1974.

    Source

    spData::nc.sids (CC0), from Cressie N, Chan NH (1989). Spatial modeling of regional variables. Journal of the American Statistical Association 84:393-401. Build script: data-raw/nc_sids.R.

    Examples

    epi_spatial_scan(nc_sids, x_km, y_km, sids_1974, births_1974,
  radii = c(30, 60), nsim = 99
)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 11
#>   center_x center_y radius observed expected population relative_risk
#>      <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>      <dbl>         <dbl>
#> 1     161.    3802.     60       54     26.3      13021          2.14
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: log_likelihood_ratio <dbl>, p_value <dbl>,
#> #   simulations <int>, candidates <int>
